payload.title: Move AWS identifiers to variables and install LeftBlock
payload.description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-e7c7be.

The account ID, Amplify app ID, CloudFront distribution, role ARN, bucket name and API Gateway ID in `papyrus.config.ts`, `infra/site.json`, `deploy.yml`, `tools/preview_production.py` and the docs move to GitHub and Amplify variables, following Papyrus `docs/site-hosting.md` (AWS identifiers outside Git). No history rewrite: the values are not credentials.
